description: This file defines the LowOrderFee controller class for the OpenCart admin panel, specifically handling the configuration interface for the 'Low Order Fee' total extension. It contains methods for displaying the settings page (`index`) and saving configuration changes (`save`).

classes.name: LowOrderFee
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Low Order Fee extension configuration in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets page title, prepares breadcrumb navigation, retrieves configuration settings, loads necessary models and controllers, and renders the configuration view for the Low Order Fee extension.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration settings for the Low Order Fee extension, including permission checks, updating settings, and returning success or error messages in JSON format.
